correctness.rationale: The Gibbs partition and two-edge moment identity follow exactly from a multiaffine generating polynomial. Enumerating all 512 subsets for every pair proves 36 identities F10 F01−F00 F11=q²(1−q)C where all C have strictly positive integer coefficients, fully recorded in the coefficient certificate; each of the 36 identities and three rational evaluations per pair replay correctly. Thus q∈(0,1), v,w>0 strictly imply negative covariance, without numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: K3,3 is the first non-series–parallel complete bipartite host with rank5/corank4, so the known series–parallel and low-rank theorems do not settle it. A complete, strict, activity-uniform coefficientwise certificate with one arbitrarily strong or weak bond perturbation addresses the motivated q<1 negative-dependence gap and survives the forest/connected endpoint limits; this is a meaningful finite structural case, not an isolated numeric example.
